description:
Type the issue a lease names, and remove the tolerance for short-id lease records.

## Background

`Lease.issue_id` is a `String` (`crates/jit/src/storage/claim_coordinator.rs:35`), as are the issue fields of `ClaimOp` (`:105-139`). To tolerate lease records persisted with an 8-character issue id, `ClaimsMutationGuard::resolved_active_leases` (`:294`) resolves ids through a closure and `is_issue_identity_candidate` (`:806`) accepts short forms. This checkout's `.git/jit/claims.jsonl` holds 26 acquire records with short issue ids; its five active leases are canonical. The log is replayed on each lease-enforced mutation (`:432,701`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `Lease` and `ClaimOp` hold the issue as `IssueId`.
- [hard] REQ-02: The short-id resolver closure and `is_issue_identity_candidate` are gone, together with the resolver closures that `commands/claim.rs` passes in (`:146,1707,2002,2042`), and leases match issues by `IssueId` equality alone.
- [hard] REQ-03: An active lease blocks mutation of its own issue and of no other issue, as shown by the claim coordinator tests.
- [hard] REQ-04: Code in this family, its unit-test modules included, uses issue ids only through `as_str()`, `short_id()`, `Display`, `Debug`, `Clone`, `PartialEq`/`Eq`, `PartialOrd`/`Ord`, `Hash` and serde, so it compiles unchanged once `IssueId` is the validated newtype.

## Notes

Once issue ids are validated, short-id lease records are rejected at decode; no compatibility reader is added (`@/inv/canonical-cutover`).
title: Lease records name their issue by IssueId
